points.description: States that the signature includes the name of the function (e.g. 'the function name', 'what the function is called').
points.partial_credit: Award half if the answer only refers vaguely to 'the function' or 'the function header' without identifying the name as part of the signature.

levels.says: Mentions the function or its header but does not say the name is included.

points.description: States that the signature includes the types of the parameters (e.g. 'the parameter types', 'the data types of the arguments it takes'). Giving the parameter list with types, or an example such as int, string, counts.
points.partial_credit: Award half if the answer mentions the parameters but not their types.

levels.says: Mentions that parameters (or arguments) are part of the signature but does not say their types are included.

rubric.notes: Full marks need both the function name and the types of the parameters; either wording or a correct example earns the marks. Half marks on a point are given when the answer names the function or the parameters but leaves out the specific element (the name, or the types). An answer that gives neither, or only unrelated items such as the return type or the body, earns no marks.
